page_title: BOC 2-2 DAR | Bochum v Darmstadt 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Sven Jablonski has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Julian Justvan is replaced by Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt).

89' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
89' The referee awards a corner and Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) goes over to take it.

87' What a wasted opportunity by Anthony Losilla (Bochum)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Marcel Schuhen makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
85' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
84' Substitution. Takuma Asano leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ivan Ordets (Bochum).
83' Here is a change. Christopher Antwi-Adjei is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Matus Bero (Bochum).
83' Substitution. Patrick Osterhage is replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
82' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Riemann is alert to thwart the effort.
82' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

81' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. Darmstadt can continue in their attacking effort.
80' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
80' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

76' 2 - 2 Goal! Julian Justvan manages to prod the ball to Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
75' Marcel Schuhen pulls off a great save to deny Takuma Asano (Bochum), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Bochum have a corner.
73' Substitution. Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) replaces Tim Skarke.
72' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) replaces Felix Passlack.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) replaces Philipp Hofmann.
71' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
70' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' The game is interrupted now, Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
67' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sees his long-range effort blocked.
62' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Mathias Honsak will be replaced by Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) coming on for Thomas Poppler Isherwood.

62' 2 - 1 Stunning strike! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) latches on to a precise through ball from Julian Justvan before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 2:1.
61' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marcel Schuhen.

59' What a chance that is! Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
58' Marcel Schuhen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin Stoger (Bochum).
57' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

56' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.

55' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
53' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Takuma Asano, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
52' It's a throw-in for Bochum.

48' 2 - 0 It's in! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the bottom right corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Keven Schlotterbeck. 2:0.
47' Darmstadt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Braydon Marvin Manu will be replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt).
46' Referee Sven Jablonski blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
44' Now Darmstadt have a corner. Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
43' One of the Bochum players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Darmstadt.
40' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
38' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcel Schuhen, who smothers the ball.
34' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

29' He should have scored! Anthony Losilla (Bochum) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' The corner from Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is intercepted by Marcel Schuhen.

27' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
25' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.

24' Takuma Asano (Bochum) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
23' Marcel Schuhen displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Takuma Asano (Bochum) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
22' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
21' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) sends a long ball in, but Marcel Schuhen comfortably gathers the ball.
19' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
17' Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

16' The cross fools the defence and leaves Felix Passlack (Bochum) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
15' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
14' Bochum earn a free kick.

10' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
10' Bochum take the free kick with a short pass.
8' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
6' A player from Bochum commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
2' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
2' Wonderful movement by Darmstadt. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has just begun.

Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
